bio: Under that striking term from the volcanic lexicon (Crater), this restaurant, which brings the gourmet offering of the luxurious Royal Hideaway Corales Villas to life, aims to be a showcase for the history, gastronomy and culture of the Canary Islands. The restaurant, located on the first floor of the hotel, features an open kitchen and a pleasant terrace overlooking the golf courses, with the ocean as a backdrop. Tenerife-born chef Eduardo Domínguez proposes a menu of delicate dishes that seek to promote Canary Island cuisine from a creative perspective, dedicating each season to one of the eight islands.
